captions.ayurpetofficial:
Your dog won't always bark or hide when they're stressed. Sometimes it whispers. 🐾

Diwali is 20 days away, so learn the quiet signs now, before the crackers start: a yawn when they're not tired, a quick lip lick, panting without exercise, a full body shake after a tense moment, and freezing. That last one means "I don't feel safe."

Amanda Ree of @samadogwellbeing shows you each one.

Send this to the friend whose dog "is just being difficult." Next from Amanda: 3 points that calm them.

captions.ayurpetofficial:
Crackers, the doorbell that won't stop, a house full of guests. 3 pressure points that can help your dog settle, from Amanda Ree of @samadogwellbeing:

1. Third eye, between the eyes just above the nose: a steady, gentle press for 20 to 30 seconds
2. Base of the ears, behind the ear flaps: very light pressure for 15 to 20 seconds
3. Base of the tail: gentle circles for 20 to 30 seconds

Save this for Diwali night. Go gently, watch their body language and stop if they pull away. Pain, limping or anything sudden goes to your vet first.

#AyurPet #AyurvedaForPets #DogParentsIndia #DogsOfIndia #IndieDogs #DiwaliWithPets

title: The Rs 0 anxiety wrap (DIY compression hack)

captions.ayurpetofficial:
A dupatta, folded into a Rs 0 anxiety wrap. 🐾

Gentle, even pressure around the chest helps some dogs settle when the crackers start, the same idea as a compression vest. A plain cotton dupatta, wrapped the way she shows, does the job.

One rule: watch him. If he looks comfortable, keep it on. If he freezes, paws at it or seems more stressed, off it comes. This is only for dogs that actually find comfort in compression.

For extra support on cracker nights: CoolCalm+ drops and the Calming Ashwagandha Yak Cheese Chews, link in bio. Supports calm, not a treatment.

Save this for Diwali night, and send it to the friend whose dog hides under the bed.

If your dog panics every year, talk to your vet now, not on the night.

#DiwaliWithDogs #DogAnxiety #CoolCalm #AyurvedaForPets #DogParentsIndia #DogsOfIndia #IndieDogs #AyurPet

title: The calming sweep (fireworks night)
status: HOLD: Karan to OK the new edit (no headline, cold open on her hands, 43.2 s)

captions.ayurpetofficial:
One slow stroke, head to tail, can help your dog let go of the fear. 🐾

For Diwali night, from Amanda Ree of @samadogwellbeing:
1. Find a quiet spot where your dog feels safe, and sit close
2. Hand on the head, one light stroke down the spine to the tail and down the back leg. Shake it off. Three times
3. Watch for the sigh, the yawn, the body going soft

Save this for the night the crackers start. Send it to a dog parent who dreads Diwali.

Gentle care, not a treatment. If your dog is in pain or panicking, call your vet.
